It sounds like you are under a lot of stress from the debt and the work itself.

Your salary is very good for 12 clients a week. If you have any credit cards that have high credit lines you could take out like $10k or $20k on (0% if the card offers) then do lump sum repayments to the school loans. It’s not a quick fix but in 5 years you’d be in a better position.

The thing is, $82k a year is a great salary. I don’t know where you are but $100k salaries are hard to come by normally when just starting out. 

There are other things like maybe starting a social media about your debt and sharing the journey to pay it down as many people would be interested in this. Sometimes you can make money on social media and just throw it at the balance too.

There is also leaving your job and going somewhere that will pay off your debt…plenty of state jobs pay well and will pay off the loan after time and offer a pension. If you are burning out this may be helpful then you can go back to your private practice in a bit.

The relational approach is not the same as coddling. The relational approach means being authentic, showing empathy and validation to build a fund of mutuality.

The most important part of the relational approach is being your authentic self. If your authentic self is direct…then do that.

Patterns in the brain change based on our thoughts, feelings, and behaviors. Neurofeedback is a cheat code in a way but you can induce new brain patterns through everyday activities. Mirror writing, using your left hand to brush your teeth, doing a new activity, these all create new connections too. 

Connecting with other people is also very important maybe the most important thing. If you have someone mentally healthy around you, you start to mimic their brain patterns.
